slides.title: Every subscription is a *decision you made *once.
Write down every *repeat charge.
slides.body: Software, apps, memberships, the trial you forgot.

slides.title: Would you buy it *again today?
slides.body: Not 'might I need it'. Would you pay for it now?

slides.title: If not, *cancel it now.
slides.body: Not later. While the statement is still open.

slides.title: Re-decide *monthly.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
